newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper settles firmer, nearby picture good.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper settles firmer, nearby picture good.

text.p: COMEX copper ended firmer as the market built on gains made earlier in the week despite expectations for further increases in LME stocks on Friday, traders said.

"Business is excellent in the States and OK in Europe. Stocks are low, spreads are tight and the charts are happy," said Rich Hirsch of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell. "All of that adds up and that's what's happening."
March COMEX copper settled up 1.75 cents at 106.55 cents a lb, traded 106.80 to 104.30 cents. Spot January went out 1.95 cents higher at 108.95 cents.
Volume was estimated at 10,000 lots compared to Wednesday's official 9,037 lots.
Hirsch said there was belief in the market that although LME stocks were expected to rise modestly on Friday, inventory at the London exchange were about to stop going up.
Traders said technical tightness in looming LME dates were also helping to prop up the market. The LME cash to three months premium or backwardation on Thursday firmed a touch further to $135/$145.
